entries.title: Entry 01 | Hello, Luigi! Welcome To My Hut!
entries.description: It's time begin the quintessential Nintendo spooky game! Let's join Luigi on his breakout adventure!

entries.title: Entry 02 | Tantrum Of Terror
entries.description: Today we take on Area 1! We've got ghosts galore, but be careful not to wake the baby...

entries.title: Entry 03 | Big Boo's Hunt
entries.description: Today we begin Area 2! Mush more expansive then the first area, and many more buttons to press...

entries.title: Entry 04 | The Seer, The Servant, And The Soloist
entries.description: Today we explore deeper into Area 2! More ghosts, more portraits, and more secrets!

entries.title: Entry 05 | Spooky Scary Skeletons
entries.description: Today we finish Area 2 and take on the area boss!

entries.title: Entry 06 | What Lies Beneath The Well
entries.description: Today we delve into Area 3 and discover a very troubling secret...

entries.title: Entry 07 | Prop Hunt
entries.description: Today we search the bulk of Area 3 for the remainder of Mario's missing items!

entries.title: Entry 08 | United They Stand
entries.description: Today we take on the boss of Area 3! And they are quite infamous...

entries.title: Entry 09 | Chaos In The Dark
entries.description: Today we (attempt) to start on Area 4 but the weather has other plans...

entries.title: Entry 10 | Roof Party
entries.description: Today we start on Area 4 proper climb all the way to the roof!

entries.title: Entry 11 | Ceramics And Canadians
entries.description: Today we trudge through Area 4, it's cold underbelly, and catch every boo along the way!

entries.title: Entry 12 | Till Death Do We Art
entries.description: Today we take on Area 4's boss and collect the 50th and final boo! Just remember to collect that diamond...

entries.title: Entry 13 | King Boo Down Below
entries.description: Today we take on King Boo at long last and finish the game!
